body.title: Submit artifacts for signoff
body.summary: Add openSignoff: the holder rule on the issue of the unit that holds the stage (the Story's issue for a BUILD), the policy stage check, the approval and review prerequisites (the lifecycle review, or the Story's code-review record for BUILD), one request through the port linked from the unit issue, and open-signoff recorded on every artifact with the request Reference.
acceptanceChecks: openSignoff refuses a missing approval or review naming it, a non-holder and an unassigned unit, and uses the Story's issue for a BUILD
For BUILD a missing, author-written or blocking code review is refused and the lifecycle review is never consulted
One request is opened and open-signoff is recorded on every artifact with the Reference
A repeat after a partial recording finds the open request and records only the rest

tests.name: src/workflow/team/__tests__/signoff.test.ts: openSignoff refuses a missing approval, a missing or author-written review for DEF, HLD and LLD, a stage the policy does not list, and a submitter who is not the holder
src/workflow/team/__tests__/signoff.test.ts: openSignoff refuses an unassigned unit saying it must be claimed first

src/workflow/team/__tests__/signoff.test.ts: openSignoff for BUILD checks the Story's code-review record (missing, written by the author, or blocking is refused; pass or warn by the other party is accepted) and never the lifecycle review

src/workflow/team/__tests__/signoff.test.ts: openSignoff for BUILD reads the holder of the Story's issue and links the request from it even when claimUnits puts BUILD on task units, and settleSignoff for a story unit selects LLD and BUILD while an epic unit selects DEF and HLD

src/workflow/team/__tests__/signoff.test.ts: openSignoff opens one request, records open-signoff on every artifact with the Reference { entityId: ref, type: signoff-request, relation: tracked-by }, and finds the open request on a repeat after a partial recording
